text: The 1048 backout exactly restores its three code files; the 1066 reland restores the same code blobs and adjusts tests to supply a valid default account. The historical changes use POP3 accounts with identities, rather than relying on Local Folders to satisfy compose setup. The retained mailto test explicitly sets an email identity, defaultAccount and account cleanup. Current send tests use shared SMTP, Exchange and Graph setup instead. Preserve the production precondition in fixtures and inspect failure results before attributing the original backout to a specific test. Static inspection supports this component scope. No runtime test was run for this lesson, and full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is still pending.
title: Update compose fixtures when a new production precondition is intentional
